prompt: I want to generate a 15-second Instagram Reels promo video for our new analytics launch with voiceover subtitles so the captions aren't blocked by Instagram's Like/Share buttons or 4:5 feed crop. Let's set it up in Remotion.
expected_behavior: Runs the 4-Step Pre-Generation Discovery Wizard (or confirms missing options such as Brand Profile and Motion Style) before writing Remotion code
Applies the Instagram Reels 9:16 (1080x1920) safe-zone insets (top >= 285px, bottom >= 420px, right >= 165px) and keeps Closed Captions inside Y: 1040px-1200px
Uses deterministic useCurrentFrame() + spring()/interpolate() animations without CSS transitions or @keyframes

prompt: /the-motion-designer create a reusable transparent animated speaker lower-third overlay that our video editor can drop into Premiere Pro.
expected_behavior: Asks which Brand Profile / guidelines to load via the Pre-Generation Discovery Wizard
Configures the composition background as transparent and provides the exact Apple ProRes 4444 alpha CLI command (--codec=prores --prores-profile=4444 --image-format=png --pixel-format=yuva444p10le)
Drives entrance and exit animations via useCurrentFrame() and spring()

prompt: My Remotion video looks fine in the browser preview, but when I run npx remotion render to MP4, the images flicker and my Tailwind animate-bounce / CSS transitions jump randomly across frames. Help me fix it.
expected_behavior: Identifies non-deterministic CSS transitions/Tailwind animate-* classes and raw tags as the root cause of headless frame-render flickering
Replaces CSS transitions and Tailwind animations with useCurrentFrame() + spring()/interpolate(..., { extrapolateRight: 'clamp' })
Replaces raw tags with from 'remotion' and checks @remotion/* package version parity
